semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical process systems and materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Gentech Co., Ltd. offers comprehensive solutions for critical process systems in the semiconductor industry, focusing on electronics grade specialty gases, ultra high purity gas and chemical delivery systems, and wet chemicals. They also provide total gas and chemical management services, enhancing the self-reliance of the semiconductor supply chain in China.
capabilities: Ultra high purity gas delivery systems
Total gas and chemical management (TGCM) services

regional_presence.China: The company focuses on enhancing the self-reliance of the industrial chain and supply chain within China.
